title: V6 R-1 dataset.json (one market / source per dataset)

dataset_id.description: unique; results go to <out>/<dataset_id>/ and are never overwritten

timezone.description: IANA zone of the CSV timestamps (used when an ISO timestamp has no offset), e.g. UTC, America/New_York, Asia/Kolkata

date_range.description: declared range, inclusive, in session-local dates; rows outside it FAIL the file

data_source.description: vendor + endpoint / product, e.g. 'Coinbase Exchange public REST /products/{id}/candles'

adjusted.description: 'unknown' is accepted but labelled in every output

retrieval_date.description: ISO date (or datetime) the data were downloaded; recorded, not inferred

segments.description: [[name, HH:MM, HH:MM], ...] in UTC; default ASIA 00-08, EUROPE 08-13:30, US 13:30-21, LATE 21-24; Sat/Sun = WEEKEND

holidays.description: optional; otherwise the calendar = union of session dates present in the dataset's valid files

items.description: per-file values override the dataset-level ones; after merging, instrument, exchange, timeframe, timezone, date_range, data_source and adjusted are REQUIRED for every file
